newsitem.title: GREECE: STRINTZIS LINES SAYS Q3 TURNOVER UP 17.7PCT.
newsitem.headline: STRINTZIS LINES SAYS Q3 TURNOVER UP 17.7PCT.

text.p: Passenger shipper Strintzis Lines said its turnover rose 17.78 percent to 15.39 billion drachmas in the first eight months of the year from 13.07 billion in the same period a year ago.
It said passenger traffic was up 12.4 percent, vehicle traffic up 9.0 percent and trucks up 7.8 percent.

Turnover from domestic operations grew 16.96 percent to 4.38 billion drachmas, the Greece to Italy line did 24.2 percent better at 7.56 billion drachmas and its operations in Ireland rose 6.5 percent to 3.44 billion drachmas, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
